problem: The public navigation exposed two different destinations for the label Platform: the desktop route opened /product while a mobile/overlay route opened /bedrijfsgeheugen.
root_cause: Multiple navigation shells can coexist and a late CMS/navigation overlay can reintroduce an outdated Platform href after the static shell has loaded.
decision: Treat /product as the canonical destination for every navigation anchor whose visible label is Platform and enforce that contract in the shared navigation runtime.
prevention: Late CMS or shell mutations are rechecked for the canonical Platform route.
Production acceptance requires click readback of both desktop and mobile/overlay Platform links.
